Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 108. Category: feat. Saiyan Feats.

U7/U6
Super Saiyan, the ultimate power of the Saiyan race,
many don’t have the skill to take it “even further
beyond”. This feat can only be taken after Super Saiyan
1 is unlocked. This feat can be taken twice, the first time
granting you Super Saiyan 2, the second time giving you
Super Saiyan 3.
SSJ 2 Teen Gohan
